study_boundary: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (Greater Mumbai) footprint, covering 24 municipal wards across Mumbai City and Mumbai Suburban districts, as the city denominator (approximately 483.22 sq km in BMC's 2024-25 Environment Status Report). Evidence for the wider Mumbai Metropolitan Region, Thane, Palghar, or Raigad must remain explicitly labelled as wider-frame context.
evidence_gaps: borehole lithology and basalt aquifer geometry with depth
recent ward- or district-resolved groundwater levels and quality
land subsidence, reclaimed-land, and geotechnical constraints

include_domains: aquifer geometry, disposition, boundaries, thickness, weathered zones, fractured zones, and productive depths
groundwater levels, monitoring wells, seasonal and long-term trends
groundwater resource assessment, recharge, extraction, stress, and status
groundwater quality, sampling locations, parameters, exceedances, salinity, seawater intrusion, and trends
exploratory wells, piezometers, pumping tests, and borehole logs that directly characterize aquifers or groundwater
supporting_evidence: geology, lithology, structure, reclaimed land, soils, or land use only when directly required to interpret aquifer geometry, recharge, groundwater flow, salinity, quality, or well depths
exclude_domains: general geology or lineament mapping without a direct aquifer or groundwater role
standalone soil mapping without recharge, infiltration, groundwater-quality, or aquifer relevance
seismic hazard, deformation, land subsidence, and microzonation without a direct groundwater relationship
metro, utility, tunnel, foundation, and infrastructure studies without groundwater observations or aquifer evidence

source_policy.older_dynamic_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved or historical lead
source_policy.older_stable_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved lead and search for an in-window successor
